prompts.loading: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated loading-screen background for Chronicles of Fortune, an isometric pixel-art fantasy board RPG. Create a polished panoramic 16:9 fantasy kingdom painting in detailed hand-crafted pixel art, consistent chunky pixel clusters rather than vector or blurry concept art. Jade green woodland, winding stone paths connecting small slate-blue-roof medieval towns with honey-lit windows, a beautiful cream-stone teal-roof castle on a floating island, waterfalls spilling into mist, distant frosted mountains to the right and violet magical islands far away. Upper-left warm morning light, cool violet shadows, muted brass/gold accents. Adventurous and inviting. The central lower third has calm dark teal mist and minimal detail so real Thai loading text and a progress panel can overlay it. Rich scenic foreground around outer edges, expansive magical horizon. NO text, no lettering, no logo, no interface, no border. Full-bleed landscape image, 1792x1024 or wider.
prompts.ui: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square nine-slice UI panel frame for Chronicles of Fortune, a fantasy pixel RPG. Produce one front-facing perfectly square symmetrical antique brass and dark jade frame, aligned to all four image edges, 1024x1024. Flat orthogonal geometry, thin brass edge bars near image edges; four ornate 100px corners engraved with oak leaves and a small jade gemstone. Ornament confined to outer 115 pixels. Inner 794x794 square completely plain uniform very dark ink teal #101e24 with no gradients or decoration, for real Thai interface content. Restrained refined crisp pixel art clusters, honey highlights from upper left, muted tarnished brass, cool violet shadow. Edge bars must be simple straight lines to stretch using nine-slice. NO text, letters, buttons, mockup, symbols in center, or perspective. Opaque background.
prompts.natureOne: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment sprite atlas for Chronicles of Fortune, a detailed isometric pixel-art fantasy board RPG. One perfectly regular 3 columns by 3 rows sprite sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, square 1536x1536. Each of the NINE equal 512x512 cells contains ONE entire separate environment object, completely inside its cell with at least 55px of transparent empty margin on ALL FOUR sides. No object crosses a cell boundary. All roots and all branches fully visible, nothing cropped. Ground roots near the bottom center of each cell. Camera orthographic isometric 2:1, upper left lighting. Cohesive detailed pixel-art clusters, tinted dark outlines, jade greens, honey warm highlights, cool violet shadows, natural hand-painted charm, transparent outside the object. No square floor tile and no solid background. Subjects in strict row-major order: row1 column1 an old rounded green OAK TREE with twisting trunk and exposed roots (grassland); row1 column2 a lush deep green WEEPING WILLOW with dangling foliage and visible root base (forest); row1 column3 a tall RAINFOREST BANYAN with mossy roots and small ferns (waterfall forest). Row2 column1 a whole SNOW-COVERED FIR tree from tip to roots (snow); row2 column2 a curving DATE PALM with all fronds and sandy root base (desert); row2 column3 a CHARRED GNARLED TREE with small glowing ember cracks at roots (volcano). Row3 column1 a cluster of THREE HUGE BLUE-GREEN CAVE MUSHROOMS with complete stalks and rocky roots (cavern); row3 column2 a tall colorful TEAL AND CORAL SEA FAN with whole branching silhouette and stone root (coral); row3 column3 a whole TWISTED PURPLE THORN TREE with hanging dim lantern fruit and complete roots (abyss). No text, no labels, no numbers, no grids, no shadows detached from roots. This is a reusable sprite sheet, NOT a scenic illustration. Exact equal 3x3 layout and generous empty transparent gutters are essential.
prompts.natureTwo: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment sprite atlas for Chronicles of Fortune, detailed isometric pixel-art fantasy board RPG. A perfectly regular 3 columns by 3 rows sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Square 1536x1536 canvas; NINE equal 512x512 cells. ONE entire separate tree or environment object per cell. Whole tip to whole root visible. Roots centered near lower cell. Orthographic isometric 2:1 view, upper-left honey light and cool violet shaded faces. prompts.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric environment sprite sheet for fantasy pixel-art board RPG Chronicles of Fortune. A perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows sheet, wide landscape 1536x1024, true TRANSPARENT background. Six equal 512x512 cells. Each cell holds ONE ENTIRE complete object with generous 55px transparent padding on ALL four sides. No crop, no contact with adjacent cells. Full roof, tower tip, foundation, bridge endpoints and roots remain visible. Orthographic 2:1 isometric view, matching detailed hand-crafted pixel-art clusters, dark colored outlines, warm upper-left light, cool violet shadows. Buildings retain teal/slate roofs, honey glowing windows and brass trim adapted to biome. Subjects EXACT row-major order: row1 col1 a complete imposing DARK ABYSS CASTLE with violet slate roofs, charcoal stone, turquoise crystal and purple windows, entire castle and base visible; row1 col2 a complete small ABYSS TAVERN INN with twisted dark timber, violet slate roof and warm amber windows, tiny hanging tankard sign, intact foundation; row1 col3 a whole VOLCANIC DUNGEON LANDMARK consisting of a large dark obsidian stone archway carved with ember runes and a modest magma pool contained at its base. Row2 col1 a whole VOLCANIC DUNGEON MAGIC PORTAL, obsidian arch framing glowing violet magical opening, small ember crystals and complete stone footings; row2 col2 a complete VOLCANIC KINGDOM CASTLE, black basalt fort with copper red roofs and golden windows, no lava obscures its silhouette, whole base visible; row2 col3 a complete short VOLCANIC BASALT BRIDGE spanning a narrow lava channel, both ends and both foundation piers fully visible, flame braziers, full bridge isolated. Each item must fit comfortably entirely within its cell. No floor tile diamond; keep bases small. NO text, labels, numbers or grid. Transparent outside each sprite.
